calculation.description: Ranks assets by five-trading-day reversal only when they are at least 5% below their trailing 20-day high. The signal is intended to capture oversold rebounds while avoiding unconditional reversal exposure. Forward return is next-day close-to-close return.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across reported periods: 2020-2022 IC 0.07825 (ICIR 0.18593), 2023-2024 IC 0.03721 (0.09256), 2025-2026 IC 0.12082 (0.32356), and 2027 year-to-date IC 0.12500 (0.68788). Sparse activation and small conditional cross-sections require conservative use.
